MilkBoy in Philadelphia is one of those rare spots that perfectly blends great food, strong drinks, and authentic city energy. Located right on Chestnut Street, it’s both a café by day and a lively bar and music venue by night, drawing a diverse crowd of locals, students, and visitors. The atmosphere is relaxed yet buzzing, with a hint of grit that feels very “Philly.” The staff is friendly and down-to-earth, giving the place an unpretentious charm.

The menu covers all the essentials with a creative twist—everything from hearty breakfast sandwiches to burgers and bar snacks. Their breakfast burrito and grilled cheese are local favorites, and the coffee is surprisingly solid for a place that also serves whiskey and craft beer. The live music adds to the appeal, with small acts and local bands often performing upstairs, making it a go-to spot for discovering new talent.

Excellent service, very friendly staff. The place has a vibe all its own that's equal parts local bar and paradoy if commercial spots like hard rock cafe. customer_insights: Aku's Kitchen is a cozy takeout spot in West Philadelphia known for its delicious Ghanaian cuisine, particularly waakye and kelewele. The owner, Aku, is praised for her friendly service, making it a beloved local gem despite being open only on weekends.

googleReviews: If this was just based on service.... I would give this place 5 stars. Every server checked on us. Every server got an order from us. Every server took an empty dish from our table. The hostess could have been alil more friendly but everyone else.. all smiles..eager to meet our needs. Nothing was too big of a request. The drinks were amazing. I ordered their new Mango Remy mojito...Delicious! The passionfruit margarita was one of the best I ever had. The steak with onions and rice and gandules... Wow! My boyfriend got the chicken in lemon butter... Out of this world! We definitely said we need to come back during the night night. They had hookah available as well. The booth were cozy and private. You must try this place!

I had my birthday party here. Fred, the owner of this nice place, along with his team made sure my party of 25 was well taken care of. Food was great. I ordered the Pull Pork! Delicious! Dj was playing amazing Spanish music so bring your Salsa Dancing shoes!

This was my very first time here.  I had a great time with my lovely date. The vibe inside was electric. But the thing that stood out to me most was the service.  My 2 servers constantly checked on us to make sure we were satisfied and if we needed anything else to make our stay more enjoyable.  You gotta come see for yourself.  The only reason why I didn't give it 5 stars is because it took a while for our food to come out. But once it arrived,  it was worth it. I had the red snapper.  The presentation was so real that it almost made the fish seem still alive on my plate.  I enjoyed the decor, the many TV screens,  even one at your personal booth and the DJ was on point and took special latin requests after a nice tip I felt obligated to go him because he was so gracious.  I recommend checking this place out. No riff raff either. This is a place you can take your lady to.

Been here many times over the years. like many places in philly, once they start getting really popular, the food and service start to suffer. theyre still a good 3.5 overall but i definitely dont go here as often as i used to.

Food is soooooo good! Love the arroz con gandules and arroz con camarones in the cute oyas. Steak is tender. Ceviche is so fresh and yummy! Ropa vieja sooo good!!!  Reasonable prices. Always something happening and they do a lot for and in the community. Happy hour 3-6pm, Taco Tuesdays 2 for $5, Thursdays karaoke, Free salsa lessons on Tuesdays at 8pm, comedy shows and live music on various weekends and they go ALL OUT for holidays w decor...big celebration coming up for Cinco de Mayo. An oasis in the community! Big space & 10 mins from Center City. Took friends there for my birthday and they ALLLLL loved it and some even ordered food to take home. They host events, fundraisers, birthdays. Many community leaders frequent the restaurant and host their events here. Plenty of free parking. Welcoming & fun atmosphere w professional & courteous staff. Stylish decor where can have privacy in a booth, a large table of friends, or sit around the bar which is always packed. They also have hookah.Highly recommend! And kid-friendly w plenty of FREE parking!
customer_insights: Izlas Puerto Rican Cuisine in Philadelphia is a vibrant spot known for its excellent service and delicious traditional dishes. With a lively atmosphere, it offers a variety of events including karaoke and salsa lessons, making it a great choice for both casual dining and nightlife.

googleReviews: Went to Mona on a Saturday night. The only reservation I can get was 5 PM. First impressions when you walk into the restaurant is that it is beautiful. Well designed an excellent decor. We were seated immediately and waitress was at our table within a minute. We were first asked if we wanted anything to drink. We decided on Almaza a beer from Lebanon and peach of Poseidon. The beer was very good and an interesting flavor but the peach drink was not as good. Was supposed to be sweet but was not. As for appetizer we started with the “little of everything“ this gave you a taste of for different spreads of your choosing. I would recommend. Next we asked if there was a chef menu in which we could taste many different items. There is not. You can either go with a meal for each individual person or you can go with tapas ( small plates) we chose to go with small plates. We chose two different kebabs. One was the colossal shrimp and the other was the fillet both were very good. From the mezze menu I would definitely recommend the dumplings. The service was average to above average. Nothing to write home about had to wait for a while for a second drink. The food does come out quickly. It’s a ready kitchen. Overall I would give Mona four stars mainly for the atmosphere. The food is pretty good not the best I’ve had. Total price with tip for two people $150.

About a month ago, I tried Mona with some friends. None of us had been here before. The inside is gorgeous..definitely a venue made for events of all kinds, especially celebrations. The food is delicious and worth the price! We all enjoyed our entrees. I tried the chicken, another the mona fries, the sausage, the bronzeno, lamb chops and for the table the hummus sampler. The waitress was friendly and I really enjoyed the atmosphere. We got to see a few birthday celebrations and they go all in with the lights and celebration. If your looking for a unique and special venue you got to check out Mona!

My friends took me here for my birthday last week. The interior design is aesthetically pleasing, very chic and posh. Our server Peter was attentive and he recommended the best. The food and drinks were amazing. Would highly recommend!

Great atmosphere! Very upscale with good food and great drinks. Service was top tier (happy hour) and food tasted homemade. Really enjoyed experience, my only issue is the bathrooms are downstairs. I just wish bathrooms were more accesible to customers at the bar. Everything else is great.

I did not get the same treatment as the other guests. I’m going to give the service a 2 star solely from the my birthday experience. I booked a week in advance and mentioned my birthday. I witnessed 2 birthday celebration before mine and 1 after mine. Each birthday celebration turn the lights off for a dedication for the birthday person but mine was rushed and not the same experience. Food amazing but the overall bday experience was not the same across the boards. The positive it the food was great, ambiance was great, atmosphere was great, even the server was nice… it’s just the bday experience was not the same experience.
customer_insights: Mona offers a chic and upscale atmosphere perfect for celebrations and special occasions. While the food is generally well-received, service can vary, especially during busy times. The venue is ideal for both intimate gatherings and lively nights out.

googleReviews:
Great Dim Sum！
Grand Palace Restaurant was delicious! All the dim sum dishes were fresh, hot, and full of flavor. Huge variety, fast service, and everything we tried
-dumplings, siu mai, buns, chicken feet, and more-tasted amazing. They also host weddings and special events, making it a perfect spot for great food and celebrations.
Highly recommended!

All around my favorite place to go when I am in or even passing by Philadelphia. The food is fresh and authentic. My favorite thing to get is the dim sum and salt and pepper squid/shrimp. The staff and attentive, friendly and and fast. This a great place for a date, solo eating, birthday party for any age. The provide live music some nights.

We are visiting Philly and stopped by for some dim sum around 1:30 in the afternoon and were seated right away, no wait at all. I love the traditional push carts; they give the place such a nostalgic vibe. Of course that means you'll have the push carts ladies always coming by to ask if you want more and more and more! You'll just have to let them know no is no when you've had enough. The food was solid overall. Our favorites were the shrimp rice rolls and the beef balls. We also ordered the beef offal, and I was pleasantly surprised that they gave multiple pieces of spleen, usually you only get one, so that was a nice bonus. The tripe was a little tough, but everything else hit the spot.

I absolutely love this place! I called this place home when I moved to the area. The staff are extremely friendly and caring. The food is undescribably good!! Authentic well seasoned food!! The tea verity is the best. Great music. Sometimes they have live music. Great decore and calm loving atmosphere. Best place to come!! Highly recommend

We attended a friend’s wedding at Grand Palace and were pleased with the service, which was friendly and attentive. However, the food was disappointing. The sashimi was not fresh, and the overall presentation of the dishes was lacking — it didn’t meet the standard we expected from other similar venues. Additionally, the candy and snack bar had mold on some of the items, including the peanuts. Thankfully, we noticed it in time and prevented our kids from eating any.

While the service was commendable, the food quality and cleanliness issues were concerning and not what we anticipated for such an important event. We hope they take these concerns seriously and improve moving forward.
customer_insights: Grand Palace Restaurant is a beloved spot for authentic dim sum in Philadelphia, offering a nostalgic dining experience with traditional push carts and a friendly atmosphere. While most reviews praise the food and service, there are some concerns regarding food quality during events, highlighting the need for consistency.

googleReviews: Amazing flavorful food. Messy and absolutely delicious. Had a wonderful date here with my girlfriend and she tried mango lassi for the first time! We truly enjoyed the paneer and chicken tikka tacos. Owner is very nice. Highly recommend.

Tikka Mahal is a great spot with lots to offer.The samosa chaat was easily our favorite..very flavorful. We also tried the channa masala rice bowl and the chicken tikka masala rice bowl. Both were solid, comforting, and nicely seasoned. Nothing fancy, just good food that feels homemade. We’ll definitely be back.

Just went here yesterday for dinner and already craving it again today. So far one is the best Indian food places I’ve found in Philly. The Dal was so delicious and the tikka masala had a perfect kick. The na’an was freshly made and all the food comes out hot and fresh. Everyone there was extremely friendly and accommodating. I’m looking forward to trying some paneer dishes. It was so hard to decide which dish to get, I wanted everything!

Absolutely outstanding experience!
The food was bursting with authentic flavor — every dish felt freshly made and beautifully spiced. The service was warm, attentive, and genuinely friendly. The atmosphere was modern yet cozy — perfect for a relaxed BYOB evening. One of the best Indian dining experiences in Philadelphia. Highly recommend!
Chicken 65 here is as close to the real thing. We had shrimp vindaloo and chicken tikka masala, everything came out in time and fresh. Prompt service. Good addition to the neighborhood.
customer_insights: Tikka Mahal offers a delightful dining experience with flavorful and authentic Indian cuisine. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, making it suitable for dates and casual outings. Customers appreciate the attentive service and the homemade feel of the dishes.

googleReviews: LOVE !! Having Fishtown Seafood so close to us, Bryan is extremely helpful and knowledgeable as is his crew. The wife and I enjoy seeing the oyster selections broken down and rated as to how large, small, salty, plump, or sweet they are. Bryan showed us first hand at the front counter how to shuck an oyster, so we purchased a knife along with two dozen of the best oyster we have had in a while. We have been back several times and even purchased several dozen to bring to our friends in Richmond VA. Go visit and help support this hidden gem in Haddonfield.

Amazing quality and super knowledgeable. I absolutely love their selection for a fork dropping good dinner. Any reservations you may have about making a dish will be squashed with the care and guidance these fine folks can provide. We’re going to do an Oyster Shucking class! What a cool concept?!? Simply put, Fishtown Seafood is my go to when I’m in town!

Got some seafood filling and shrimp… wow !! The lovely dude at the front counter gave us some good tips and we enjoyed some homemade seafood ravioli with vodka sauce and shrimp! Would definitely recommend checking out this cute little corner fish spot.

We’ve been so happy to know that Fishtown Seafood is around the corner. Bryan  is highly knowledgeable and passionate about what he sells and makes great recommendations every time! We enjoy the Friday happy hour oyster selections, and recently tried the sashimi grade salmon which was delicious! We used the salmon to make a ceviche.
It’s so great to have a small business in the neighborhood that offers fresh and responsibly sourced seafood. It’s become our go-to spot!

Fishtown Seafood has an amazing variety of fish and seafood options. The quality is amazing and you can really taste the difference. Bryan is highly knowledgeable and directly sources the seafood. The fish packaging even reveals the captain of the boat’s name; it’s clear to see that everyone involved with getting the seafood to your door is proud of the product they sell.
happy_hour_details: Friday happy hour with oyster selections
customer_insights: Fishtown Seafood is a beloved local seafood market known for its high-quality offerings and knowledgeable staff. Customers appreciate the hands-on experience, including oyster shucking classes and personalized recommendations, making it a great spot for casual dining and social gatherings.
